Good morning Ismael ferrahi, hope you doing well.
Please note that certain issues, such as gas interruptions, water leakages, or other unforeseen maintenance-related matters, may occasionally occur and are beyond our direct control. We trust that the building team has already attended to and resolved the issue. However, if the matter remains unresolved, kindly let us know so that we may follow up with the building management, as they are responsible for handling such concerns.
